enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Breathe deeply. Move legs. Lie still. Turn head. Shift position. Stretch arm. Turn to back. Rub face. Pull blanket down. Push blanket up. Lie still. Breathe.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Stretch arms. Yawn. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.
Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out cereal. Take out bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Pick up bowl. Put bowl in sink. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Check phone. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Take out phone. Put on headphones. Listen to music.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Greet colleagues. Say 'Good morning'. Put on uniform. Check schedule. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Check patient vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Record notes. Walk to nurse station. Use computer. Answer phone. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care. Update records. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Check phone. Listen to music.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink. Rinse plate.

Enter living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Turn on computer. Open browser. Type website. Scroll. Click link. Watch video. Type message. Send message. Open game. Play game. Adjust monitor. Move mouse. Click. Type. Scroll. Check email. Reply email. Listen to music. Turn off computer.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair.
Enter living room. Pick up book. Sit on couch. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Put down book.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed (brushing teeth, etc.)
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Dry hands. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Lie still. Turn to back. Move arm. Breathe deeply. Remain sleeping. Shift position. Stretch. Turn head. Sigh.
